QUOTE: "`createPost` in `app/actions/remote/post.ts:74` first writes the post to the local database with a temporary `pending_post_id`, so it shows in the UI right away." and "If that throws, it builds an `errorPost` with `props.failed = true` (lines 164–172) and writes it to the DB"

VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the post is written locally before sending and, on failure, kept in the DB with `failed = true`.
